verdict.rationale: The only grounding in official sources is the International Entrepreneur Parole page, which states specific investment and grant thresholds as "CPI-adjusted per USCIS". That ties a public claim to official government policy figures. Nothing else in the pack shows claims backed by government data. Missing for 10: USCIS processing-time or approval-rate data, FOIA statistics, linked citations to official policy sources, and grounding beyond a single page.
